lines: Called Vajra by knowledge-born indeed; so from both branch ends, from triangle center emerged root of liṅga should penetrate.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vajrākhyāṃ jñānajenaiva tathā śākhobhayāntataḥ koṇamadhyaviniṣkrāntaṃ liṅgamūlaṃ vibhedayet
